TextBlock.Name: Title
TextBlock.Text: You are in Grandfather Tolliver's workshop. A brass key hook on the wall hangs empty — only a frayed string still dangles from it. Soft sawdust covers the floorboards like a golden blanket. A small pet door is cut into the workshop's main door to the north, and an old cuckoo clock ticks softly on the wall. The tool bench lies to the east.
